title: Earned Enchants
description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that locks enchantments behind natural gameplay milestones.
body: Earned Enchants — A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that locks enchantments behind natural gameplay milestones. Mine blocks to unlock Efficiency, take fall damage to earn Feather Falling, kill mobs for Sharpness — every enchantment is earned through play, not luck. Compatible with Easy Magic and Better Advancements
